caption: This sounds like a conspiracy theory… but it's in the National Archives 😳 After WW2, the US secretly hired Nazi scientists, and one of them built the Moon rocket. Was it worth it? 👇 #operationpaperclip #history #conspiracy #declassified #ww2 #nasa #dailydrop

scenes.title: Nazis built *the Moon rocket?*
scenes.say: This sounds like a crazy conspiracy theory. Nazi scientists, secretly brought to America, building the rocket that went to the Moon. But it's true.

scenes.title: An *SS officer*
scenes.say: Wernher von Braun built Hitler's V-2 missile. He was a Nazi Party member and an SS officer. In 1945, he surrendered to the Americans.

scenes.title: *~20,000* prisoners died
scenes.say: His rockets were built underground by concentration camp prisoners. Around twenty thousand of them died. More than the V-2 ever killed as a weapon.

scenes.title: *1,500+* scientists
scenes.say: Instead of a trial, the US brought him and more than fifteen hundred German scientists to America. Their Nazi pasts were played down in their files.

scenes.title: To *the Moon*

label.name: SATURN V
label.role: Designed under von Braun at NASA

scenes.say: At NASA, von Braun's team built the Saturn Five. In 1969, it took Apollo eleven to the Moon.

scenes.title: The verdict:
scenes.say: The verdict: confirmed. It's all in the National Archives. Secret Nazi UFOs, though? No evidence.
